title: Don't See Evidence That US is on 'Back Heels' Against Iran, Says Megan Ortagus
title_cn: 梅根·奥塔古斯表示，没有看到美国对伊朗“紧追不舍”的证据

title: Rocket Lab Drops on Launch Pushback; Riot Platforms' Anthropic Deal | Stock Movers
title_cn: 火箭实验室因发射推迟而放弃； Riot Platforms 的 Anthropic Deal |库存搬运工
summary:
On this episode of Stock Movers: 

- Anthropic PBC has struck a $9.1 billion deal with Riot Platforms (RIOT), a Bitcoin mining company that recently began selling AI data center capacity. Riot disclosed it had secured a 20-year deal to supply 191 megawatts of capacity from its Rockdale, Texas, campus to a “leading frontier AI” company. 
- Rocket Lab (RKLB) shares drop as much as 5.7% after the company’s Neutron timeline softened, with an analyst saying that while Neutron remains on track to reach launch pad in the fourth quarter, it could push an initial launch to 2027. 
- Babcock & Wilcox Enterprises (BW) rose in premarket after the company signed an agreement with Siemens Energy to produce steam turbine generator sets.
- US-listed shares in On Holding (ONON) drop as much as 17% in premarket trading after the Swiss sneaker maker’s second-quarter sales were lower than expected.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: EU Study Warns Pesticide Import Curbs Risk Lifting Food Prices
title_cn: 欧盟研究警告农药进口遏制风险推高食品价格
summary: A European Union study found that proposed curbs on farm imports treated with pesticides risk pushing up consumer prices, adding to trade concerns raised by agricultural powerhouses such as the US and Brazil.

title: US Fires on Ship Breaking Iran Blockade: WSJ
title_cn: 美国对打破伊朗封锁的船只起火：《华尔街日报》
summary: The Wall Street Journal says US forces fired on Panama-flagged ship that tried to break through the American naval blockade of Iran. It happened Tuesday morning. Oil prices moved higher on the news. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Pakistan Says US-Iran Are Close to Some Arrangement on Peace
title_cn: 巴基斯坦称美伊即将达成某种和平安排
summary: Pakistan’s defense minister Khawaja Asif said the US and Iran are close to “some sort of an arrangement,” adding that a lasting peace will be in the region’s interest.
